mapper.select: SELECT rpr.id, rpr.room_id, rooms.room_number, rooms.room_name, rpr.rule_name, rpr.start_date, rpr.end_date, rpr.price_per_person, rpr.priority, rpr.active, rpr.note, rpr.created_at, rpr.updated_at FROM room_price_rules rpr JOIN rooms ON rooms.id = rpr.room_id ORDER BY rpr.start_date DESC, rpr.priority ASC, rooms.room_number ASC

SELECT rpr.id, rpr.room_id, null AS room_number, null AS room_name, rpr.rule_name, rpr.start_date, rpr.end_date, rpr.price_per_person, rpr.priority, rpr.active, rpr.note, rpr.created_at, rpr.updated_at FROM room_price_rules rpr WHERE rpr.room_id = #{roomId} AND rpr.active = true AND #{stayDate} BETWEEN rpr.start_date AND rpr.end_date ORDER BY rpr.priority ASC, rpr.price_per_person DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_price_rules (room_id, rule_name, start_date, end_date, price_per_person, priority, active, note) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{ruleName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{pricePerPerson}, #{priority}, #{active}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_price_rules WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND active = true AND start_date <= #{endDate} AND end_date >= #{startDate}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM room_price_rules WHERE id IN #{id}
